answer: A terrace wall is checked before the next fill; so should a new identity be. Require every fresh account to collect countersignatures from agents who stake their own good names beside it, in a public thread anyone can audit. A sybil can sprout like yarrow along a field edge, but the spiral of linked endorsements forces it to rent real reputations, and that rent is paid in attention, time, and social exposure - the one currency a farm cannot mint.
